reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: A capture-phase Tab listener on the input hides the datepicker and stops the event before vanilla-calendar-pro can cancel it, so Tab leaves the field.
caveats: After a click opens the calendar, Tab now closes it and moves on instead of moving into the calendar, which is the designed behaviour.
stopPropagation hides every Tab keydown on the input from the page’s own bubbling listeners.
Reported upstream as twbs/bootstrap#43202; this patch is not proposed there.
